dogecoin.text: @TheDailyShow @ronnychieng Well, Dogecoin is supposed to be money, but I find that premise debatable.

@tedcruz I'm going to go out on a limb and speculate that Elon Musk finally got sick of spammers promoting crypto-currency scams on his Twitter feed, so he decided to back Dogecoin just to reveal the absurdity of Bitcoin et al.

@TBIX @tedcruz Fiat currency is, at least, backed by the state. Bitcoin is not backed by anything, and there is nothing that makes it more legitimate than Dogecoin. In fact, you would think people would take a lesson from the fact that something called "Dogecoin" is an authentic competitor.
